title: Overpermissioned
description:
A fictional Linux host has a scheduled cleanup job. During an authorized lab review, the analyst captured this directory listing:

```
-rw-r--r-- 1 root    root     2201 Mar  3 09:58 cleanup.conf
-rwxr-xr-x 1 root    root      914 Mar  3 09:59 cleanup.sh
-rwxrwxrwx 1 analyst analysts   812 Mar  3 10:00 rotate.sh
-rw-r--r-- 1 analyst analysts   455 Mar  3 10:00 audit.log
```

The instructor asks which file is world-writable.
objective: Submit the world-writable filename as HC{filename}.

hints.text: Permission triples are owner, group, other. Look for `rwx` in the final triple.
A mode of `rwxrwxrwx` means everyone can write to the file.
